resources.string: CHAOS — THIS PHONE IS A CLIENT

A CLIENT uses a CORE elsewhere and loads nothing itself. On the desktop, open CHAOS and press CORE, then type the address and key it shows here.

The engine itself is now on this phone — the line above is measured by Chaos running here, not by Android. What is missing before this phone can be a CORE is loading a model file and running the token loop; the bridge is done. HELPER is not finished on any device: chaos-worker speaks the protocol but no CORE routes work to it.

Cache, threads and device settings are missing here on purpose: they decide how a model RUNS, so they belong to whichever machine runs it.
Turn the dial. Everything else follows from this.
Only this device. Nothing else can reach it.
Uses a CORE elsewhere. Loads nothing here.
Lends the memory and cores of this device to a CORE.
Holds the models and answers. Others connect here.
